summary: Kandal M Venture Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 24, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq minimum bid price deficiency letter on December 22, 2025, and a subsequent grant of an additional 180-day compliance period (until December 21, 2026) from Nasdaq on June 23, 2026. No price, premium, or transaction terms are stated. The board is evaluating options to regain compliance. The filing is a routine regulatory update on a listing standard deficiency, not a special-situation event. Watch for any future reverse stock split or other compliance plan.
